noCapture: This card captures nothing - you may lay it off.

tutorial.table: The table cards are numbered. Pick a card from your hand and **the groups it can take** appear as choices - a single card of the same value, a set summing to your card, a set that **plus your card makes fifteen**, and an **ace sweeping the whole table** when no ace lies on it. **Unlike Scopa, a same-value card on the table does not shut the other captures out.**
tutorial.scores: Points come from most cards, most denari, the 7 of diamonds, primiera, piccola, grande, scope and the deal bonuses. First to **51** wins - but **taking all ten denari wins outright**.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. **You cannot lay a card off while a capture is available.**
tutorial.playButton: Pick a card, then press the group you want to take. "Lay off" appears only when nothing can be captured.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
